author: rorupuntou
content:
**EPF Dev Update — Roropuntou**

- **Project:** EEST: BLS12-381 (EIP-2537) Subgroup Checks and Field Deserialization Hardening
- **Upstream PR:** https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3641 (co-authored with @spencer-tb on GitHub)
- **Dev Update (HackMD):** https://hackmd.io/npFjnHStSaWsJhWNJnyk9A
- **Cohort 7 PR:** https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-seven/pull/453

**Summary & Key Highlights:**
- Extended test coverage across multi-pair MSM (`BLS12_G1MSM`, `BLS12_G2MSM`) and pairing operations.
- Enforced strict subgroup checks preventing bypass under zero scalars (s = 0), dirty top-16 byte padding verification across batched calldata, and modulus overflow boundary validation (x >= p).
- Mutation testing against the EELS reference implementation confirmed our 6 test cases were the only tests in the entire global test suite catching these specific bug classes.
- Verified 100% consensus pass rate across 6 production L1 clients: Geth, Erigon, Besu, Nethermind, Revm, and Ethrex.
